reference_sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT week_start, SUM(reconciliations_run) AS reconciliations
  FROM usage_weekly
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-06' AND DATE '2025-12-29'
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT week_start, reconciliations,
  reconciliations - LAG(reconciliations) OVER (ORDER BY week_start) AS change_reconciliations
FROM weekly
alternatives:
WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT week_start, SUM(reconciliations_run) AS reconciliations
  FROM usage_weekly
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-06' AND DATE '2025-12-29'
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT w.week_start, w.reconciliations, w.reconciliations - p.reconciliations AS change_reconciliations
FROM weekly w
LEFT JOIN weekly p ON p.week_start = w.week_start - 7

other_way.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  -- one row per week of the range
  SELECT week_start, SUM(reconciliations_run) AS reconciliations
  FROM usage_weekly
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-06' AND DATE '2025-12-29'
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT w.week_start, w.reconciliations, w.reconciliations - p.reconciliations AS change_reconciliations
FROM weekly w
LEFT JOIN weekly p ON p.week_start = w.week_start - 7
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each week to the Monday seven days earlier finds the week before by date, but LAG is shorter when no week is missing.
